# Mixx-DJ-MCP - LLM Index

## Overview

Control Mixxx open-source DJ software through natural language.
Search your library, cue tracks, set loops, apply effects, and mix — all from your AI assistant.

## Key Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/server.py` | FastMCP app, lifespan, tool registration |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/bridge/osc_bridge.py` | OSC UDP client to Mixxx (ports 11118/11119) |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/bridge/protocol.py` | OSC address constants for all Mixxx controls |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/deck_control.py` | `mixx_deck` portmanteau — transport, cues, loops, sync |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/library.py` | `mixx_library` portmanteau — search, browse, metadata |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/effects.py` | `mixx_effects` portmanteau — chains, parameters |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/mixer.py` | `mixx_mixer` portmanteau — crossfader, EQ, gain |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/stems.py` | `mixx_stems` portmanteau — stem separation |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/transitions.py` | `mixx_transition` portmanteau — AI transitions |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/vinyl.py` | `mixx_vinyl` portmanteau — vinyl control |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/controller.py` | `mixx_controller` — USB auto-detect |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/daw.py` | `mixx_daw` — DAW export |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/skin_manager.py` | `mixx_skin` — skin management |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/smart_crate.py` | `mixx_crate` — LLM crate creation |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/tools/set_sequencer.py` | `mixx_set` — AI set sequencing |
| `src/mixx_dj_mcp/config.py` | Environment-based configuration |
| `bridge/README.md` | Mixxx OSC configuration and address reference |
| `start.ps1` | SOTA startup script |
| `web_sota/` | React/Vite/Bun webapp dashboard |
| `native/` | Tauri 2.0 NSIS build pipeline |

## Quick Commands

```bash
uv sync                          # Install Python deps
uv run uvicorn mixx_dj_mcp.server:app --port 11116 --reload   # Dev server
uv run pytest tests/ -q          # Run tests
uv run ruff check src/           # Lint
just build-native                # Build NSIS installer
mcpb pack . dist/mixx-dj-mcp.mcpb  # Build MCPB bundle
```

## Ports

| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 11116 | Backend (FastMCP HTTP + REST) |
| 11117 | Frontend (Vite dev server) |
| 11118 | Mixxx OSC output (feedback from Mixxx) |
| 11119 | Mixxx OSC input (commands to Mixxx) |

## Mixxx Setup

1. Preferences → MIDI/OSC → Enable OSC
2. Output port: 11118, Input port: 11119
3. Send to: 127.0.0.1
4. Restart Mixxx

See `llms-full.txt` for comprehensive tool reference, OSC address mappings, and troubleshooting.
